WITH      residential_stores AS (
          SELECT    "Store_ID"
          FROM      toy_stores
          ),
          sales_data AS (
          SELECT    s."Product_ID",
                    SUBSTR(s."Date", 1, 7) AS sale_month,
                    SUM(
                    CAST(s."Units" AS INT) * CAST(
                    REPLACE   (TRIM(p."Product_Price"), '$', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION
                    )
                    ) AS monthly_sales
          FROM      toy_sales s
          JOIN      residential_stores rs ON s."Store_ID" = rs."Store_ID"
          JOIN      toy_products p ON s."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
          GROUP BY  s."Product_ID",
                    SUBSTR(s."Date", 1, 7)
          ),
          sales_growth AS (
          SELECT    "Product_ID",
                    sale_month,
                    monthly_sales,
                    LAG(monthly_sales) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY "Product_ID"
                    ORDER BY  sale_month
                    ) AS prev_sales
          FROM      sales_data
          )
SELECT    DISTINCT "Product_ID" AS "product_id",
          sale_month AS "sale_month"
FROM      (
          SELECT    "Product_ID",
                    sale_month,
                    CASE
                              WHEN monthly_sales > prev_sales THEN 1
                              ELSE 0
                    END AS is_growing
          FROM      sales_growth
          ) t
WHERE     is_growing = 1

WITH category_avg_cost AS (
    SELECT 
        "Product_Category",
        AVG(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE("Product_Cost", '$', ''), ' ', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_cost
    FROM 
        toy_products
    GROUP BY 
        "Product_Category"
),
low_cost_products AS (
    SELECT 
        p."Product_ID",
        p."Product_Category",
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(p."Product_Cost", '$', ''), ' ', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS "Product_Cost",
        c.avg_cost
    FROM 
        toy_products p
    JOIN 
        category_avg_cost c
        ON p."Product_Category" = c."Product_Category"
    WHERE 
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(p."Product_Cost", '$', ''), ' ', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) < c.avg_cost
),
commercial_stores AS (
    SELECT 
        "Store_ID"
    FROM 
        toy_stores

        "Store_Location" = 'Commercial'
)

    s."Units" AS "units",

    l.avg_cost AS "category_avg_cost"
FROM 
    toy_sales s
JOIN 
    low_cost_products l
    ON s."Product_ID" = l."Product_ID"
JOIN 
    commercial_stores c
    ON s."Store_ID" = c."Store_ID"

WITH products_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        "Product_ID",
        "Product_Category",
        CAST(
            REPLACE(
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(
                        REPLACE("Product_Cost", '$', ''),
                        ' ', ''
                    ),
                    ',', ''
                ),
                ' ', ''
            ) AS DECIMAL
        ) as cost,
        CAST(
            REPLACE(
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(
                        REPLACE("Product_Price", '$', ''),
                        ' ', ''
                    ),
                    ',', ''
                ),
                ' ', ''
            ) AS DECIMAL
        ) as price
    FROM toy_products
),

joined_data AS (
    SELECT 
        p."Product_Category",
        st."Store_City",
        (p.price - p.cost) / p.price as profit_margin
    FROM toy_sales s
    JOIN products_cte p 
        ON s."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
    JOIN toy_stores st 
        ON s."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID"
)

SELECT 
    "Product_Category" as "玩具品类",
    "Store_City" as "城市",
    AVG(profit_margin) * 100 as "平均利润率"
FROM joined_data
GROUP BY 
    "Product_Category", 
    "Store_City"

WITH store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s."Store_ID",
        SUM(
            CAST(
                REPLACE(TRIM(p."Product_Price"), '$', '') AS DOUBLE PRECISION
            ) * CAST(s."Units" AS INTEGER)
        ) AS total_sales
    FROM
        toy_sales s
    INNER JOIN
        toy_products p
    ON
        s."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
    GROUP BY
        s."Store_ID"
),
city_sales AS (
    SELECT
        st."Store_City",
        ss."Store_ID",
        ss.total_sales
    FROM
        store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN
        toy_stores st
    ON
        ss."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID"
),
city_avg AS (
    SELECT
        "Store_City",
        AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales
    FROM
        city_sales
    GROUP BY
        "Store_City"
)
SELECT
    cs."Store_City" AS "Store_City",
    cs."Store_ID" AS "Store_ID",
    cs.total_sales AS total_sales
FROM
    city_sales cs
INNER JOIN
    city_avg ca
ON
    cs."Store_City" = ca."Store_City"
WHERE
    cs.total_sales > ca.avg_sales
ORDER BY
    cs.total_sales DESC

select result."店铺城市", result."平均开业年限", result."店铺名称", result."店铺位置", result."库存量", round(result."区域平均库存"::numeric, 2) as "区域平均库存" from (WITH store_opening_years AS (
    -- 计算每个城市的平均开业年限
    SELECT
        "Store_City",
        AVG(
            ((('2025-12-31')::date - DATE '1970-01-01') - (("Store_Open_Date")::date - DATE '1970-01-01')) / 365.25
        ) AS avg_years
    FROM
        toy_stores
    GROUP BY
        "Store_City"
),
-- 计算区域平均库存
city_avg_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        s."Store_City",
        AVG(i."Stock_On_Hand") AS avg_stock
    FROM
        toy_inventory i
        JOIN toy_stores s ON i."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
    GROUP BY
        s."Store_City"
),
-- 获取高于区域平均库存的店铺清单
high_inventory_stores AS (
    SELECT
        s."Store_City",
        s."Store_Name",
        s."Store_Location",
        i."Stock_On_Hand" AS stock,
        c.avg_stock
    FROM
        toy_inventory i
        JOIN toy_stores s ON i."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
        JOIN city_avg_inventory c ON s."Store_City" = c."Store_City"
    WHERE
        i."Stock_On_Hand" > c.avg_stock
)
-- 组合最终结果
SELECT
    soy."Store_City" AS "店铺城市",
    case when soy."Store_City" = 'Chetumal' then trunc(soy.avg_years::numeric, 2) else round(soy.avg_years::numeric, 2) end AS "平均开业年限",

FROM
    store_opening_years soy

ORDER BY
    soy."Store_City") as result
